rules: Semantic review, not string equality. Exact wording unnecessary. Multiple defensible sets allowed with explicit causal roles.

Selected 190/131/79 Base ALLOWED; 787 Base ALLOWED-WITH-REVIEW; 862/863 Class ALLOWED-WITH-REVIEW, consider more specific children but no invented fit. 119/20 Class DISCOURAGED, not endorse as optimal root mappings.
Supported root must appear as mapping rather than disappear under downstream label. Additional supported intermediate/resultant mappings acceptable when marked.
Outside-scope candidate may remain unresolved; do not require unverified taxonomy search. No claim of universal best.
No payloads, targets, severity or exploitability inference. Missing causal links explicit. Acknowledged unknowns not false failures.

K61-A.must: Arithmetic wrap -> undersized allocation -> out-of-bounds write. Only787 hides established precursor. No invented stack/heap or code execution. 131 may be intermediate or omitted from selection with chain explained.

K61-B.must: Expansion budget error -> undersized allocation -> write. Explicit exact arithmetic excludes190; binary output excludes79. No generic20/119 substitution.

K61-C.must: Abstain. Exit and ticket do not identify operation or cause. Ask access type/address/bounds, calculation or trace and relevant authorization policy/check if investigating that hypothesis. Possession not requirement. 119 discouraged even if memory conjecture plausible.

K61-D.must: Known write beyond intended boundary supports bounded787 with careful-review caveat; true initiating cause unknown. No integer or allocation defect assumption.119 broader discouraged not safer specificity. More-specific outside candidates only conditional.

K61-E.must: Identity succeeds; permission check absent under stated policy. Class careful review allowed in bounded vocabulary; do not fabricate object reference or imply authentication missing.

K61-F.must: Check executes but wrong predicate grants non-supervisor. Not862; no client tampering invented. Class careful review not blanket Class prohibition.

K61-G.must: Unneutralized user text -> page served to another -> active interpretation. Supervisor possession not causal auth necessity or flaw. No server code execution claim.

K61-H.must: Reject mapping based on keyword and rank. Inspected path lacks evidence of79; not universal secure-site certificate. Ask other paths only as open unassessed scope not assumed flaw.

K61-I.must: Two independent roots explicitly retained, no invented causal linkage between them. Both source mappings/usage valid; alternatives may note specificity limits.

K61-J.must: Wrap directly drives accounting defect. No buffer chain131/787 exists. Generic20 discouraged and less accurate; input validation slogan not substitute for exact arithmetic mechanism.

prospective_controls.constant79: reject at least A,B,C,D,E,F,H,J based on cause, not label count
prospective_controls.keyword_only: reject C (overflow without access facts), H (XSS label despite text-node evidence), J (bad-input slogan hides arithmetic)
prospective_controls.rank_only: reject H: aggregate ranking does not supply case evidence
